arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْـدِكَ وَرَسُولِـكَ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ، وَاخْصُصْهُمْ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَسَلاَمِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad ʿabdika wa rasulika wa ahli baytihit-tahirin wa-akhṣuṣhum bi-afḍali ṣalawātika wa-raḥmatika wa-barakātika wa-salāmika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad, Thy slave and Thy messenger, and his Household, the pure, and single them out for the best of Thy blessings, Thy mercy, Thy benedictions, and Thy peace!

arabic_text: وَاخْصُصِ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِدَيَّ بِالْكَرَامَةِ لَدَيْكَ، وَالصَّلاَةِ مِنْكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
transliteration: wa akhṣuṣi allahumma wālidayya bil-karāmati ladayka wa al-ṣalāti minka yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
english_text: And single out my parents, O God, for honour with Thee and blessings from Thee, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَلْهِمْنِي عِلْمَ مَا يَجبُ لَهُمَا عَلَىَّ إلْهَاماً، وَاجْمَعْ لِي عِلْمَ ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ تَمَامـاً،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waʾalhimnī ʿilma mā yajbu lahuma ʿalayya ilhāman wajmaʿ li ʾilma dhalika kullihi tamāman
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, teach me through inspiration knowledge of everything incumbent upon me toward them, and gather within me knowledge of all that completely!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ اسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا تُلْهِمُنِي مِنْـهُ، وَوَفِّقْنِي لِلنُّفُوذِ فِيمَا تُبَصِّـرُنِيْ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ، حَتَّى لاَ يَفُوتَنِي اسْتِعْمَالُ شَيْء عَلَّمْتَنِيْهِ، وَلاَ تَثْقُلَ أَرْكَانِي عَنِ الْحُفُوفِ فِيمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِيهِ.
transliteration: thumma istaʿmilnī bimā tulhimunī minhu wa waffiqnī lin-nufūḏi fīmā tubassirunī min ʿilmih ḥattá lā yafūtanī istiʿmālu shayʾ ʿallamtanīh walā tathqul arkānī ʿani al-ḥufūfi fīmā alhamtanīhī
english_text: Then make me act in accordance with what Thou hast inspired me and give me the success to put into practice the knowledge Thou hast shown to me, lest I fail to act according to something Thou hast taught me or my limbs feel too heavy to perform that with which Thou hast inspired me!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا أَوْجَبْتَ لَنَا الْحَقَّ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ بِسَبَبِهِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih kamā sharraftanā bihī wa ṣalli ʿala muḥammad wa ālih kamā awjabta lanā al-ḥaqq ʿalā al-khalq bi-sababih
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, as Thou hast ennobled us through him, and bless Muhammad and his Household, as Thou hast made incumbent upon us rights toward the creatures because of him!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَهَابُهُمَا هَيْبَةَ السُّلْطَانِ الْعَسُوفِ، وَأَبَرُّهُمَا بِرَّ الأُمِّ الرَّؤُوفِ،
transliteration: allahumma ij'alni ahābuhumā haybata as-sultānil ʿasūf wa ʾabarruhumā birr al-umm al-raʾūf
english_text: O God, fill me with awe of my parents, the awe one has toward a tyrannical sovereign, and let me be devoted to them, with the devotion of a compassionate mother!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ طَاعَتِي لِوَالِدَيَّ وَبِرِّيْ بِهِمَا أَقَرَّ لِعَيْنِي مِنْ رَقْدَةِ الْوَسْنَانِ، وَأَثْلَجَ لِصَدْرِي مِنْ شَرْبَةِ الظَّمْآنِ حَتَّى أوثِرَ عَلَى هَوَايَ هَوَاهُمَا
transliteration: wa-jʿal ṭāʿatī li-wālidayya wa birrī bihimā 'aqarra li'aynī min raqdah al-wasnāni wa ʾathlaja li-ṣadri min sharbat al-ẓamʾān ḥattá ʾawthira ʿalá hawāya hawāhumā
english_text: Make my obedience and devotion to them more gladdening to my eyes than sleep to the drowsy and more refreshing to my breast than drink to the thirsty, so that I may prefer their inclination to my inclination,

arabic_text: وَأُقَدِّمَ عَلَى رِضَاىَ رِضَاهُمَا وَأَسْتَكْثِرَ بِرَّهُمَا بِي وَإنْ قَلَّ وَأَسْتَقِلَّ بِرِّي بِهِمَا وَإنْ كَثُرَ.
transliteration: wa-uqaddima ʿalā riḍāyā riḍāhumā wa-astakthira birrahumā bi wa in qalla wa astaqilla birri bihima wa in kathura
english_text: set their satisfaction before my satisfaction, make much of their devotion to me though it be little, and make little of my devotion to them though it be great.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ خَفِّضْ لَهُمَا صَوْتِي، وَأَطِبْ لَهُمَا كَلاَمِي، وَأَلِنْ لَهُمَا عَرِيْكَتِي، وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيْهِمَا قَلْبِي،
transliteration: allāhumma khaffiḍ lahumā ṣawtī wa aṭib lahuma kalāmī waalin lahuma ʿarikatayya wa'atif 'alayhima qalbi
english_text: O God, lower before them my voice, make agreeable to them my words, make mild before them my temper, make tender toward them my heart,

arabic_text: وَصَيِّرْنِي بِهِمَا رَفِيقاً، وَعَلَيْهِمَا شَفِيقاً.
transliteration: waṣayyirnī bihimā rafīqan, wa ʿalayhimā shafīqan
english_text: and turn me into their kind companion, their loving friend!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اشْكُرْ لَهُمَا تَرْبِيَتِي وَأَثِبْهُمَا عَلَى تَكْرِمَتِي، وَاحْفَظْ لَهُمَا مَا حَفِظَاهُ مِنِّي فِي صِغَرِي.
transliteration: allāhumma shukr lahumā tarbiyatī wa athibhumā ʿalā takrimatī wa aḥfaż lahuma ma ḥafiżahuma minni fi ṣiġari
english_text: O God, thank them for my upbringing, reward them for honouring me, and guard them as they guarded me in my infancy!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا مَسَّهُمَا مِنِّي مِنْ أَذَىً أَوْ خَلَصَ إلَيْهِمَا عَنِّي مِنْ مَكْرُوه أَوْ ضَاعَ قِبَلِي لَهُمَا مِنْ حَقٍّ فَاجْعَلْهُ حِطَّةً لِذُنُوبِهِمَا وَعُلُوّاً فِي دَرَجَاتِهِمَا
transliteration: allāhumma wamā massahumā minnī min 'adhāin aw khalas'a ilayhimā 'annī min makrūhin 'aw ḍāʿa qib'alī lahuma min ḥaqqin fa-jʿalhu ḥiṭṭatan li-dhunūbihimā waʿulluwwan fi darajātihimā
english_text: O God, and whatever harm has touched them from me, detested thing has reached them from me, or right of theirs which has been neglected by me, allow it to alleviate their sins, raise them in their degrees,

arabic_text: وَزِيَادَةً فِي حَسَنَاتِهِمَا
transliteration: wa ziyādatan fī ḥasanātihimā
english_text: and add to their good deeds!

arabic_text: يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ.
transliteration: yā mubaddil as-sayyiāti bi'aḍʿāfihā min al-ḥasanāt
english_text: O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا تَعَدَّيَا عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنْ قَوْل، أَوْ أَسْرَفَا عَلَىَّ فِيْهِ مِنْ فِعْل، أَوْ ضَيَّعَاهُ لِي مِنْ حَقٍّ أَوْ قَصَّرا بِي عَنْهُ مِنْ وَاجِب فَقَدْ وَهَبْتُهُ وَجُدْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا،
transliteration: allāhumma wa mā taʿaddayyā ʿalayya fīhi min qawl aw asrafaa ʿalayya fiihi min fiʿl aw ḍayyaʿāhu lī min ḥaqqin aw qaṣṣarā bī ʿanhū min wājib faqad wahabtu-hu wajadtu bihi 'alayhimā
english_text: O God, whatever word through which they have transgressed against me, act through which they have been immoderate with me, right of mine which they have left neglected, or obligation toward me in which they have fallen short, I grant it to them and bestow it upon them,

arabic_text: وَرَغِبْتُ إلَيْكَ فِي وَضْعِ تَبِعَتِهِ عَنْهُمَا فَإنِّي لا أَتَّهِمُهُمَا عَلَى نَفْسِي، وَلاَ أَسْتَبْطِئُهُمَا فِي بِرِّي، وَلا أكْرَهُ مَا تَوَلَّياهُ مِنْ أَمْرِي يَا رَبِّ
transliteration: wa raghibtu ilayka fi wadh'i tabi'atihima 'anhumā fa inni la attahimu huma ala nafsi walā astabṭiʿuhumā fī birrī walā ʾakrahū mā tawallayāhu min amrī yā rabb
english_text: and I beseech Thee to remove from them its ill consequence, for I do not accuse them concerning myself, find them slow in their devotion toward me, or dislike the way they have attended to my affairs, my Lord!

arabic_text: فَهُمَا أَوْجَبُ حَقّاً عَلَيَّ، وَأَقْدَمُ إحْسَانـاً إلَيَّ وَأَعْظَمُ مِنَّةً لَـدَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أقَاصَّهُمَا بِعَدْل، أَوْ أُجَازِيَهُمَا عَلَى مِثْل،
transliteration: fahumā awjabu ḥaqqan ʿalayya wa aqdamu ihsanan ilayya wa'aẓamu minnatan ladayya min an aqāṣṣahumā bi'adl aw ujāziyahumā ʿalā mithl
english_text: They have rights against me which are more incumbent, precedence in beneficence toward me that is greater and kindness toward me that is mightier than that I should settle accounts with justice or repay them with equivalents.

arabic_text: أَيْنَ إذاً يَا إلهِيْ طُولُ شُغْلِهِمَا بِتَرْبِيَتِي ؟
transliteration: ʾayna idhan yā ilahī ṭūlu shughlihimā bi tarbiyatī?
english_text: Where then, my God, would be their long occupation with bringing me up?

arabic_text: وَأَيْنَ شِدَّةُ تَعَبِهِمَا فِي حِرَاسَتِيْ ؟
transliteration: wa ʾayna shiddatu taʿabihimā fī ḥirāsatiyy?
english_text: Where the hardship of their toil in taking care of me?

arabic_text: وَأَيْنَ إقْتَارُهُمَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا لِلتَّوْسِعَةِ عَلَيَّ؟
transliteration: waʾayna iqtāruhumā ʿalā anfusihimā liltawsiaʿati ʿalayya?
english_text: Where the stinting of themselves to provide me with plenty?

arabic_text: هَيْهَاتَ مَا يَسْتَوْفِيَانِ مِنِّي حَقَّهُمَا، وَلاَ اُدْرِكُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ لَهُمَا وَلا أَنَا بِقَاض وَظِيفَةَ خِدْمَتِهِمَا.
transliteration: hayhat ma yastawfiyan minni haqqahuma walā udriku mā yajibu ʿalayya lahuma wa lā anā bi-qāḍi waẓīfat khidmatihimā
english_text: What an idea! I can never discharge their right against me, fulfil my obligations toward them, or accomplish the duty of serving them.

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعِنِّي يَا خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتُعِينَ بِهِ.
transliteration: fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa ʾaʿin-nī yā khayra mani istuʿīna bih
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household and help me, O Best of those whose help we seek!

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْنِي يَا أَهْدَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ،
transliteration: wa waffiqnī yā ahda man rughiba ilayhi
english_text: Give me success, O Most Guiding of those whom we beseech!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي فِي أَهْلِ الْعُقُوقِ لِلآباءِوَالأُمَّهاتِ يَوْمَ تُجْزى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لاَيُظْلَمُونَ.
transliteration: walā tajʿalnī fī ahl al-ʿuqūq lil-ābāʾ wa al-ummahāt yawma tu-jzā kullu nafs bi-mā kasabat wa-hum lā yuẓlamūn
english_text: Place me not among the people of disrespect to fathers and mothers on the day when "every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, they shall not be wronged" (45:22).

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَاخْصُصْ أَبَوَيَّ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا خَصَصْتَ بِهِ آبَاءَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاُمَّهَاتِهِمْ يَا أَرْحَمَ الـرَّاحِمِينَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa dhurrīyatih wa-akhṣuṣ abawayya bi-afḍali mā khaṣṣata bih "ʾābāʾa ʿibādika al-muʾminīna waʾummahātihim yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad, his Household, and his progeny and single out my parents for the best which Thou hast singled out for the fathers and mothers of Thy faithful servants, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَهُمَا فِي أَدْبَارِ صَلَوَاتِي وَفِي أَناً مِنْ آناءِ لَيْلِي، وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِ نَهَارِي.
transliteration: allāhumma lā tunsinī dhikrahumā fī adhbāri ṣalawātī wa fee ana min aana'i laylee wa fī kulli sāʿatin min sāʿāti nahārī
english_text: O God, let me not forget to remember them after my ritual prayers, at every time throughout my night, and in each of the hours of my day!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاغْفِرْ لِي بِدُعَائِي لَهُمَا، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمَـا بِبِرِّهِمَـا بِي، مَغْفِرَةً حَتْمـاً وَارْضَ عَنْهُمَا
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa ġfir lī bi duʿāʾī lahuma wa-ghfir lahumā bi-birrihimā bī maghfiratan hatman wa arda 'anhumā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, forgive me through my supplication for my parents, and forgive them through their devotion toward me with unfailing forgiveness, be well pleased with them

arabic_text: بِشَفَاعَتِي لَهُمَا رِضَىً عَزْماً، وَبَلِّغْهُمَا بِالْكَرَامَةِ مَوَاطِنَ السَّلاَمَةِ.
transliteration: bi shafāʿatī lahumā riḍan ʿazman waballighhumā bil-karāmati mawāṭina as-salāmāh
english_text: through my intercession for them with resolute good pleasure, and make them reach through Thy generosity the abodes of safety!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُكَ لَهُمَا فَشَفِّعْهُمَا فِيَّ، وَإنْ سَبَقَتْ مَغْفِرَتُـكَ لِي فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيْهِمَا، حَتّى نَجْتَمِعَ بِرَأفَتِكَ فِي دَارِ كَرَامَتِكَ وَمَحَلِّ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka lahuma fashaffiʿhumā fīya wa in sabaqat maghfiratuka li fashaffiʿnii fiihima ḥattá najtamīʿa bi-raʾfatika fī dāri karāmatik wa maḥalli maghfiratika wa raḥmatika
english_text: O God, if Thy forgiveness reaches them first, make them my intercessors, and if Thy forgiveness reaches me first, make me their intercessors, so that we may gather together through Thy gentleness in the house of Thy generosity and the place of Thy forgiveness and mercy!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ وَالْمَنِّ الْقَدِيْمِ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ .
transliteration: 'innaka dhū al-faḍl al-'aẓīm wa al-mann al-qadīm wa 'anta 'arḥamu al-rāḥimīn
english_text: Verily Thou art Possessor of abounding bounty and ancient kindness, and "Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful" (7:151)!
